title: The Brake Pad You Can See Can Look Fine While the Hidden Pad Is Gone
topic: Inner and outer brake pads can wear unevenly
mechanicTruth: Inner and outer pads on a disc-brake assembly can wear unevenly; sticking slide hardware, caliper piston issues, hydraulic restrictions, or pad binding can contribute, so the wear pattern should be diagnosed rather than treated as a pad-only verdict.
